         <milestone n="11. gzhan lugs dgag pa" unit="section"/>  
         gzhan lugs dgag pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3887">kha cig</rs><note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3887">gnyal zhig</rs></note> na re | sgrub pa tsaM gyi mtshid ni gzhan don du rnamkhyen chen po 3 thob par bya ba'i phyir chos thaMd mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis slob par byed pa yin la| byeg du chos sku thob pa'i don sbyor ba kunas slong byed kyi bsaM pa'i go gyon pa 'jug pa seMs bskyed pa <note type="gloss">go</note> ni sgrub | 
         theg chen la sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyi tshul bzhin du <lb n="62a8"/> zhugs pa ni 'jug sgrub| bsgoms pas byang chub chen po dngos su skyed pa ni tshogs sgrub| bsgoms pas rnam mkhyen dngos su 'byung bar byed pa ni nges 'byung sgrub pa'o || zhes gsungs pa ni ma yin te | </seg></TEI>
